title: 第15章 走后门第16章 三个任务
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
苏铭随着纪慕青，踏入了紫云宗外门之地。
刚一到，便见那边一阵喧闹。
“哼，我们可都是家族里响当当的天才！”一个满脸傲气的青年扯着嗓子吼道，“凭啥紫云宗不收咱们？”
“就是，咱们天赋绝伦，哪能被拒之门外！”旁边一人附和，鼻孔都快朝天了。
这时，一个身着管事服饰的中年男子，一脸严肃地站出来，朗声道：“诸位莫要吵闹。紫云宗收徒，自有规矩，眼下并非收弟子之时，还请诸位一月之后再来。”
“一月之后？我们可等不了那么久！”先前那傲气青年满脸不屑，“我等天赋异禀，在家族中都是重点培养的对象，区区一个月的等待，简直是浪费我们的修炼时间！”
管事眉头一皱，神色冷峻，沉声道：“宗门规矩，不可更改。纵是天才，也得遵循。一个月，并不长，能等便等，不能等，那便请回吧。”
“你！”那青年被噎得满脸通红，恼羞成怒，“你不过是个小小的管事，竟敢如此对我们说话！信不信我让家族来收拾你们紫云宗！”
管事冷哼一声，周身气息陡然一震，一股强大的威压瞬间弥漫开来：“放肆！在紫云宗外门，岂容你这般撒野！再敢闹事，休怪我不客气！”
说罢，管事右手一挥，一道灵力如汹涌浪潮般席卷而出，直接将那几个闹事的青年轰飞出去数丈之远。
“哎哟！”那几个青年摔落在地，狼狈不堪，疼得直叫唤。
“记住了，”管事走上前，居高临下地看着他们，眼神冰冷，“不准再在此处闹事。否则，下次可就不是这么简单的教训了。”
那几个青年咬着牙，满脸不甘，却又不敢再吭声，只能灰溜溜地爬起来，一瘸一拐地离去。
此刻，苏寻和纪慕青走上了前。
纪慕青稚嫩的面容，外加一对傲人的双峰，恰似含苞待放却又风情万种的花蕊。
这般模样一现身，瞬间就像磁石一般，将周围众人的目光都吸了过来。
之前被警告的那几人，此刻皆是一脸丧气，仿若斗败的公鸡。
他们走上前来，好心提醒苏铭与纪慕青：“你们也是来加入紫云宗的吧？”
“但还得等上一个月呢，现在去根本没用。”
纪慕青嘴角轻扬，露出一抹自信的笑容，没有多说什么，她带着苏铭，径直朝着紫云宗的方向走去。

一路上，纪慕青步伐轻盈，身姿摇曳生姿，那纤细的腰肢仿若随风摆动的柳枝，每一步都踏出别样的韵味。
很快，在纪慕青的一番运作下，苏铭竟成功走了后门，加入了紫云宗。
纪慕青眨着灵动的大眼睛，笑意盈盈地说道：“我二叔可是紫云宗外门的执事呢，虽说不是啥超级大佬，但这点小权力还是有的。”
“我呀，以后也会加入紫云宗，只不过现在年纪还没到。苏铭大哥，你可得好好干！”
“有空就多去纪家找我玩，到时候咱一起闯荡，说不定能闯出一片大大的天地呢！”
纪慕青走后，苏铭瞧着自身所处，满心无奈，内心如汹涌暗流般翻涌：
“这杂役弟子的身份……”
“我远道而来，可不是为了干这些粗使杂役活儿的，分明是奔着成为正式弟子去的。”
“那秦家的秦易烟，哪像我这般，只是个杂役？她的地位，可比我高出太多了。”一想到秦易烟，苏铭眉头紧蹙，脸上闪过一丝不甘。
“若一直是这杂役身份，地位远不及秦易烟，苏家往后，怕是还得被秦家死死拿捏啊。”苏铭握紧了拳头，心中满是愤懑，目光中透着决然，仿佛要冲破这身份的桎梏。
“不过，事已至此，唯有坦然接受。”
苏铭心中暗自思忖，面上却无半分颓丧之色。
content_en:
Su Ming followed Ji Muqing and entered the outer sect of Ziyun Sect.
As soon as I arrived, I saw a commotion over there.
"Hmph, we are all well-known geniuses in the family!" A young man with a face full of arrogance shouted at the top of his voice, "Why doesn't Ziyun Sect accept us?"
"That's right, we are extremely talented, how can we be turned away!" A person next to him agreed, his nostrils almost turned to the sky.
At this time, a middle-aged man in steward's clothes stood up with a serious face and said loudly: "Don't make any noise. Ziyun Sect has its own rules for accepting disciples. Now is not the time to accept disciples. Please come back in a month."
"After one month? We can't wait that long!" The arrogant young man from before was full of disdain, "I have extraordinary talents and are the focus of training in the family. Waiting for just one month is simply a waste of our training time!"
The steward frowned, looked stern, and said in a deep voice: "The rules of the sect cannot be changed. Even a genius must follow them. One month is not long. If you can wait, you can wait. If you can't wait, then please come back."
"You!" The young man was choked and his face was red, and he became angry. "You are just a little steward, how dare you speak to us like this! Believe it or not, I will ask the family to deal with your Ziyun Sect!"
The steward snorted coldly, and his whole body suddenly trembled, and a powerful coercion instantly filled the air: "Wantless! In the outer sect of Ziyun Sect, you are not allowed to act so wildly! If you dare to cause trouble again, don't blame me for being rude!"
After saying that, the steward waved his right hand, and a wave of spiritual power swept out like a raging wave, directly sending the troublemaking youths flying several feet away.
"Ouch!" The young men fell to the ground, embarrassed, and screamed in pain.
"Remember," the steward stepped forward and looked at them condescendingly with cold eyes, "You are not allowed to cause trouble here again. Otherwise, the lesson will not be such a simple one next time."
The young men gritted their teeth and looked unwilling, but they did not dare to say anything anymore. They could only get up dejectedly and limped away.
At this moment, Su Xun and Ji Muqing stepped forward.
Ji Muqing's childish face, coupled with a pair of proud breasts, are like budding yet charming flower stamens.
As soon as he appeared like this, he was like a magnet, attracting the attention of everyone around him.
The people who had been warned before now all looked dejected, like cocks that had been defeated in a fight.
They stepped forward and kindly reminded Su Ming and Ji Muqing: "You are also here to join the Ziyun Sect, right?"
"But we still have to wait a month. There's no point in going now."
Ji Muqing raised the corner of her mouth with a confident smile. Without saying anything, she took Su Ming and walked straight towards the Ziyun Sect.
Along the way, Ji Muqing's steps were light and her figure was swaying. Her slender waist was like a willow branch swaying in the wind, giving a different charm to every step she took.
Soon, under Ji Muqing's operation, Su Ming successfully took the back door and joined the Ziyun Sect.
Ji Muqing blinked his big, smart eyes and said with a smile: "My second uncle is the deacon of Ziyun Sect's outer sect. Although he is not a super boss, he still has this little power."
"I will also join the Ziyun Sect in the future, but I'm not old enough yet. Brother Su Ming, you have to work hard!"
"When you have time, come to Ji's house to play with me. Then we can have a great time together and maybe we can create a big world!"
After Ji Muqing left, Su Ming looked at where he was, filled with helplessness, and his heart surged like a turbulent undercurrent:
"The identity of this handyman disciple..."
"I didn't come all this way just to do these menial tasks. I clearly came here to become a formal disciple."
"How can Qin Yiyan from the Qin family be just a handyman like me? Her status is much higher than mine." When thinking of Qin Yiyan, Su Ming frowned, and a trace of unwillingness flashed across his face.
"If you have always been this handyman,His identity and status are far inferior to Qin Yiyan. The Su family may have to be controlled by the Qin family in the future. "Su Ming clenched his fists, his heart full of resentment, his eyes filled with determination, as if he wanted to break through the shackles of his identity.
“However, the matter has come to this, and we can only accept it calmly. "
Su Ming thought to himself, but there was no trace of despair on his face.
